note: Open findings recorded under criteria revision A, which Jack has decided to keep. They are pinned by tests/test_validation.py: the test fails if a recorded deviation changes, whether it grows or shrinks.

findings.statement: pandapower, and an independent solver, give bus voltage magnitudes that differ from the printed IEEE 14-bus solution by up to 1.329e-3 pu, against a tolerance of 1.0e-3 pu. Only bus 4 exceeds the tolerance.
findings.ruled_out_by_test: shunt at bus 9, tap direction and line charging (validation/diagnose_14bus.py): none improves the match

findings.statement: Generator reactive output differs from the printed solution by 0.22 to 1.68 MVAr at all five generators, against a tolerance of 0.1 MVAr.
The comparison with a published 9-bus solution table is OPEN until Jack supplies inputs/LV12/case9_published.csv (columns bus,vm_pu,va_degree).
findings.closed: 2026-10-28: Anderson and Fouad, Power System Control and Stability, 2nd ed., Fig. 2.19 (p. 38), typed into inputs/LV12/case9_published.csv in the book's bus numbering and mapped to MATPOWER's by load. C9-PUB-VM PASS 3.69e-4 pu (tolerance 0.001), C9-PUB-VA PASS 0.035 degree (tolerance 0.05; the book prints angles to 0.1 degree, so the rule's own tolerance would be 0.1).
